Server-Side Parameter Pollution

July 25, 2026
Web Security API PortSwigger

Introduction

This is my write-up about Server-Side Parameter Pollution.

I will explain the vulnerability and the approach I used to solve the PortSwigger lab.

What is Server-Side Parameter Pollution?

Server-Side Parameter Pollution occurs when user-controlled input is included in a server-side request without being handled correctly.

Lab

This write-up covers the PortSwigger Web Security Academy lab and the steps I followed to solve it.

Conclusion

Understanding how parameters are processed by the backend is important when testing APIs and web applications.
